remarks:
Charming split-level offering the best of country living while remaining conveniently close to everyday amenities. Surrounded by peaceful wooded views with glimpses of Lake Erie, this move-in-ready property has been thoughtfully improved with numerous recent updates designed for comfort and low-maintenance living.
Great setting with five open acres with views of Lake Erie, attached two car garage and additional 3 bay pole barn.
The first floor has an attractive foyer, 1/2 bath with laundry, and two large versatile rooms.

Heading up the half staircase the renovated kitchen is a true centerpiece, featuring custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, a center island. The level is split with the living room complete with a stone wood-burning fireplace with heatilator and an attractive beamed ceiling. Head out the french doors onto a large wrap-around porch. 

The upper floor offers three bedrooms and 3 full baths baths, including an impressive primary suite with two private balconies, a walk-in closet, and a beautifully appointed primary bath with heated tile flooring and a tiled shower. 

With extensive updates, abundant living space, exceptional outdoor amenities, and a peaceful setting with views of the woods and Lake Erie, this property offers a rare combination of privacy, comfort, and convenience. Town of Arkwright, Fredonia Schools.
